title: SDK operator license management: invite, tier, offboard
desc: Human operator tasks for the GitHub-collaborator-based license system. Code handles detection and UX automatically; these are the manual or semi-automated steps the SDK owner must perform per customer lifecycle event.
steps: SIGNUP: collect customer GitHub username at checkout. Tier map: CDP(Pro)=100,000 KRW/mo -> permission=read, Sudo(Business)=500,000 KRW/mo -> permission=write. Send invite: gh api repos/kiexpert/wkappbot-sdk/collaborators/{username} -X PUT -f permission={read|write}
author: claude
